titulo: Kenyan airport staff strike delays thousands of passengers
cuerpo: In tonight's edition: A workers' strike at Kenya's main airport leaves travellers grounded. Also, Ghanaian cocoa farmers are ramping up their pushback against a new law preventing them from using their land for anything else without permission. And in Tunisia, the picturesque town of Sidi Bou Saïd has been recognised by UNESCO as being important to global heritage.
